notes.title: 🚛 Truck World: Australia – First Haul launches June 3rd!
notes.content:
The prologue, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694620/Truck_World_Australia__First_Haul/]Truck World: Australia – First Haul[/url], will be available for free on June 3rd — get ready for your first long haul across the Australian outback!

[h2]What is First Haul?[/h2]

This short but immersive standalone experience gives you a first taste of what we're building with Truck World: Australia. You’ll complete two missions, explore a harsh new environment, and — most importantly — get behind the wheel and feel the heart of the game: driving a truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610481/e7e681be7fe5352b341f224af72227eb6c0c8036.jpg[/img]

[h2]🛠 Community-Driven Development[/h2]

First Haul is more than a demo — it’s our first step toward community-driven development. We want to build this game together with you — real truck sim fans.

Since early this year, we’ve been playtesting the prologue and improving every part of it based on feedback:
[list]
[*]     Support for 90%+ steering wheels
[*]     Improved truck physics
[*]     Multiple transmission configurations
[*]     Enhanced sounds and controls
[*]     Dozens of bug fixes and UI improvements
[/list]

[h2]🤝 Join the community[/h2]

We’re already discussing future playtests on our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4]Discord[/url] — and we plan to run them more frequently.

If you want to help shape the future of Truck World: Australia, join the tests, share your thoughts, and be heard. Your feedback truly makes a difference.

Thanks for your support — and see you on the roads of Australia! 🦘

notes.title: Dev Log: UI Improvements and Playtest Updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, truckers! We’ve got some fresh updates for you.[/h2]

[h3]Development Updates – Dynamic UI for Controls[/h3]
We've improved how controls are displayed in the interface! Now, in-game prompts will [b]show the correct button icons for your steering wheel or gamepad[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/d2bef812522e55146a74bc2944ab56b78ce62c67.jpg[/img]

[h3]First Playtest Recap[/h3]

We’ve just wrapped up our first wave of playtests in our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4 ][Discord server][/url], and we’re really happy with the results! Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made significant improvements across the board.

As we move forward, we’re closing the application form for new playtesters, but don’t worry—we’ll continue inviting selected participants from those who have already signed up as needed. If you applied, stay tuned for potential future invites!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/c89f29a1aca951b55bad01fc9dcdba6f54b0932f.jpg[/img]

[h3]What’s Improved?[/h3]

Recent updates to Truck World: Australia have brought numerous enhancements focused on realism, usability, and immersion:
✔ Controller support improvements – better detection and configuration of gamepads and steering wheels, automated binding conflict detection, and fixes for compatibility issues—especially for popular brands like Fanatec and Simucube.
✔ Refined vehicle dynamics – improved truck mass perception, better road friction at higher speeds, and fine-tuned gear mappings for automatic transmissions.
✔ Enhanced Force Feedback (FFB) – now featuring realistic engine vibrations, better simulation of road irregularities like anti-rain grids, and smoother responsiveness thanks to FFB calculations being moved to a separate thread.
✔ Gameplay fixes – resolved unintended truck movement with the handbrake engaged, corrected input sensitivity and camera settings, and added toggle bindings for retarder and splitter controls.
✔ Enhanced immersion – upgraded truck and ambient sound positioning, improved truck engine audio, and added realistic animations for doors, mudflaps, and trailer cables.
✔ Better menus and settings – numerous visual and functional improvements to make configuring your trucking experience easier and smoother.


[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
We’re gearing up for [b]closed testing of the full demo version of Truck World: Australia[/b]! As before, we’ll keep improving the game step by step, incorporating your feedback along the way.

[h3]🚛 Add TWA to your wishlist, follow our Steam page, and spread the word! [/h3]
If you know truck sim fans, streamers, or fellow drivers, let them know about Truck World: Australia!
See you on the roads! 🛣🔥

notes.title: Steering Improvements, Force Feedback, and Player Videos from the PlayPlaytest!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, truckers![/h3]

It’s time to share some fresh news about Truck World Australia and the latest improvements we’ve made based on your playtest feedback.

[h2]🛠 Automatic Steering Wheel Configuration[/h2]
Many popular steering wheel models will now work right away upon connection—no need to manually assign every button. But if you’d like to adjust your controls, you have two convenient options:
✔ Use the configuration wizard for quick setup.
✔ Manually assign individual commands for full control over your steering.

[h2]🌍 Improved Force Feedback on Dirt Roads[/h2]
In Truck World Australia, you won’t just be driving on asphalt—you’ll also tackle dirt roads. We’ve paid special attention to how Force Feedback feels in these conditions.
Now:
✔ Terrain readability has been improved—you’ll feel bumps and loose surfaces more clearly.
✔ The truck’s handling on dirt roads is now more realistic and predictable.

[h2]🏁 Upcoming Demo News[/h2]
We’ve gathered data from the playtest and are working on an updated demo version. It will be small, more like an extended playtest, but with a few new features we hope you’ll enjoy!

[h2]🎥 Playtest Gameplay Videos[/h2]
Recently, we lifted the embargo on gameplay footage. Now you can see real, uncut gameplay! Here are some videos created by our players:

notes.title: Dev Log: Weekly Update – Playtest Embargo Lifted & Game Improvements!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, future conquerors of the Australian roads![/h3]
Today, we're sharing the latest updates on the development of Truck World Australia and giving you a look inside the ongoing closed playtest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/381e84ae8c204c2a8231058467c60a7f7ecf495e.png[/img]

[h2]Closed Playtest in Discord[/h2]
As we mentioned before, we are currently running a closed beta test in our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4 ]Discord server[/url]. Each week, we implement improvements and gather player feedback to make the game as engaging and polished as possible.
A huge thank you to everyone who has signed up and participated! We’ve received an overwhelming amount of feedback that is helping us refine the game in the best possible way.

[h2]Playtest Embargo Lifted – Share Your Gameplay![/h2]
Now, playtest participants are free to share gameplay videos and screenshots! This is a great opportunity to see raw, unedited gameplay footage directly from the players themselves.
📌 Where to find them? We've set up dedicated self-promo and screenshots channels in our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4 ]Discord [/url]where participants can share their experiences.
📢 How can you help the project?
[list]
[*] Share your favorite videos and screenshots on social media.
[*] Watch and engage with content from other players.
[*] Spread the word about the game – every mention helps us grow and improve!
[/list]

[h2]Key Game Improvements[/h2]
The playtest has already led to significant progress! Here are the key updates from the past week:
🚛 Truck & trailer physics – we're continuously refining the driving experience to make it both realistic and enjoyable.
🎥 Camera movement – we’ve added more dynamic motion, so you can now feel inertia when braking, accelerating, and turning.
🔊 Audio enhancements – improved sound design.
🛞 Wheel support – optimizing controls for different wheel models. This week, we’ve added support for Fanatec and Moza.
💨 Force Feedback – making the steering experience more realistic and responsive.

[h2]Add to Wishlist & Spread the Word![/h2]
We're making final improvements to the playtest and gearing up for the demo release! To stay updated and not miss the launch, add the game to your Steam wishlist and follow our updates.
[h3]🚛 Help us grow![/h3]
 If you love truck simulators, tell your friends and share game content on social media – there’s much more exciting news, gameplay, and updates ahead!
See you on the roads of Australia! 🛣️🔥

notes.title: Dev Log: On the Road to the Demo! First Closed Playtest and Many Improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, truckers of Australia![/h2]
We finally have something exciting to share with you! We are making great progress towards the demo, and there’s still plenty of work ahead. But for now, let’s dive into the latest updates!

[h2]First Closed Beta Test[/h2]
We have launched the first closed beta test! Right now, we are inviting players who want to help us improve the game. If you’d like to participate, sign up on our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4][b]Discord[/b][/url]!
A huge thanks to everyone already participating—your feedback is invaluable! We are currently testing [b]truck physics[/b] and [b]support for various steering wheels[/b]. Speaking of which:

[h2]Improvements to Controls and Steering Wheel Support[/h2]
In our last dev log, we introduced the new control settings and steering wheel support system. During testing, we identified and fixed several issues. Here are some of the improvements:
[list]
[*] Improve UX in the setup wizard.
[*] New tab for configuring additional control buttons.
[*] Automatic pedal inversion detection.
[*] Fixed input lag on certain steering wheels.
[*] Improved force feedback system.
[*] Fixed reverse gear functionality in H-type transmissions.
[*] Enhanced support for Fanatec and Simucube.
[*] Reworked force feedback system for more realistic behavior.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/51acf4ee574b3deaaa90367c3a74b529bf7e8037.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/f7d781cf34d1cf9b400d747ea334149b1420d998.jpg[/img]

[h2]Truck Physics Improvements[/h2]
One of the key areas of testing has been improving truck physics. We want to ensure that driving a truck feels realistic, conveying the weight and power of these massive machines. Fine-tuning such a complex system takes time, but we are making steady progress.


[h2]Updated Audio[/h2]
We have started revamping all in-game sounds, and here are some of the first updates:
[list]
[*] New engine sounds.
[*] Completely reworked ambient sounds for the first biome, the Australian desert.
[*] And many more audio enhancements that we continue to integrate.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=g3UJZYVNFi8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
Along with major updates, we’ve also added some smaller but important details:
[list]

[*] Ability to add and remove road train signs.
[*] Continued improvements and refinements to the UI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OjTTVh9.gif[/img]

[h2]Stay Tuned and Join the Playtest![/h2]
We are working hard on the upcoming demo, and there’s much more to come. Stay updated here and on our social media!
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/D4STRYY5K4][b]Discord[/b][/url] to participate in playtests, chat with the developers, and share your thoughts.

notes.title: Dev Log: First Road Trains and Revamped Controls in Truck World: Australia!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello truckers![/h3]

Today, we're excited to share two major updates: the introduction of double trailers and a complete overhaul of the control settings. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[h2]Double Trailers in Truck World: Australia![/h2]

The first implementation features a double dump trailer, consisting of two trailers connected by a standard hitch. Want to use it as a single trailer? Go ahead. But the real magic happens when you hook up both trailers!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1sjcTSA.gif[/img]

This means more work for you, but here’s how it goes:
Attach the first trailer, exit the cab, connect the hoses, and lift the landing gear.
Repeat the same process with the second trailer. Now your road train is ready to hit the highway!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PdYsXSj.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hKqXsgg.gif[/img]

But remember, mastering double trailers requires skill. Taking turns is trickier since your tail always cuts inward. Plan your maneuvers carefully and leave extra space.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dgTF3kb.gif[/img]

For easier maneuvering, you can park the trailers separately. Just lift the landing gear, disconnect the cables, and open the hitch on the second trailer. Park the first, then repeat the process for the second.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6E8nBJ7.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lsj8FDd.gif[/img]

[h2]Revamped Control Settings[/h2]

We’ve completely reworked the control system to make it as convenient and flexible as possible.
Now the game automatically detects most popular steering wheels and gamepads. In most cases, you won’t need to configure anything—just plug in and hit the road!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/9d85416dc8284fd681064c7868037c9b7495fb49.jpg[/img]

But if you want to fine-tune everything to your preferences, we’ve created an intuitive setup wizard. It will guide you through the entire process step by step:

[h3]Choose Your Control Scheme:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/11edc038d8116a5828105144a071e69606addabc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Configuring the gearbox—choose between automatic, semi-automatic, or manual.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/cafe09ff397b45603a479467f763c35921d7c209.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/703099d3c1e15a2260e362d5ad2ab818d50ec5fb.jpg[/img]

[h3]If you pick manual, you can also decide whether to use a clutch or not.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/f94b034de93ba8317878dbd1ea66c372764bdbd0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Advanced Configuration:[/h3]
Adjust every axis and button in detail. Set inversions, dead zones, or calibrate controls exactly to your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/a1a82965db00aebaae9dde9c0c638e5e9fbe85cf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Force Feedback Customization:[/h3]
We’ve added a force feedback adjustment option. Since force feedback can vary widely across different wheels, you can now fine-tune it for the most comfortable and realistic driving experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/e1a36cdb67f4ad3cd229942c49cdc0de705dbfb9.jpg[/img]

Stay Tuned!
This is just the beginning! We’re actively preparing for the upcoming demo, and there’s much more to come. Follow us on social media to stay up to date and make sure you don’t miss a thing. See you on the dusty roads of Australia!

notes.title: Dev Log: Meet the New Interface and Locations!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello truckers![/h3]

We’ve got exciting news: we’ve updated the interface and added new locations that you’ll definitely want to explore. Ready to take a peek under the hood?

[h2]Revamped Interface[/h2]

Remember the interface from Driving School?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/686d719dd6821565e15793abcb2392c34d5de5f7.jpg[/img]

Now everything looks modern and user-friendly. The new dashboard is compact, intuitive, and stylish. All essential indicators are right in front of you, so you can stay focused on the road and enjoy the journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/921c334789c707c520a43b0283cb3112cb1378fa.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mini-Map and Info Window[/h3]

We’ve combined the navigator, truck info, delivery details, and radio into a single space. You can toggle between the information you need or hide it completely to focus on driving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/138ad051c83da68aae11d9332c40670a95ee1c75.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/499aa62ea177aeb932eb423e84594ad753fc8e93.jpg[/img]

Here, you’ll see all the key truck details: fuel level, technical condition of the truck and trailer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/821a37b7dd4fd2fae33fe27498810c23fdd9d2c6.jpg[/img]

This section displays crucial order details, such as cargo weight, destination, and delivery time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/4834ba2a6cc50f98a22cdae2af219a0bc0aaa513.jpg[/img]

By the way, we’ve added internet radio! Now you can choose from several stations to keep you company on those long hauls.

[h2]New Locations[/h2]

Cargo deliveries just got more exciting with our new destinations:

[h3]Iron Ore Mine[/h3]

A massive open-pit mine near Coober Pedy. This location needs constant fuel and equipment deliveries, as well as ore transport. Get ready to navigate through heavy machinery and dusty roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/6f57d5f28edd25a2d2f19923a5c8dd574e5cec4a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/f79fe98982c0c61b1a78e79006e66aa09249665f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/35fc7043bf6f5e7ce323d3b58a9ca88e3f296abd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/893911e718aef6798155e2ff69323ce07e752b8d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/7760eaae362718bd85b392b0d4e8fda2d2b1f8c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/7fa5cdf05b3b77016275263ef0796cf864209896.jpg[/img]

[h3]Construction Site[/h3]

Pipes are being laid, and roads are under repair, so you’ll need to find detours along dirt tracks. It’s no easy task, but challenges are what you thrive on, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/21203ffb4041087513f43c8194da89b7dfa7e34e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/6ecaed7df2da1c8cf713a7b08f53f0defd2bc4da.jpg[/img]

[h3]Keep Australia Moving![/h3]

Without you, the truckers, everything grinds to a halt. So, add Truck World: Australia to your Steam wishlist and stay tuned for updates. Don’t forget to check out our socials for more exciting content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37897849/154c0bf6070297925f5b29f3798518616460a8b3.jpg[/img]

See you on the dusty roads of Australia!

notes.title: Truck World: Driving School - Update 1.2
notes.content:
Introducing Truck World: Driving School version 1.2, featuring exciting new improvements and enhancements to provide an even better truck driving experience! We've been working hard to address your feedback and requests, and we're proud to share these updates with you. Check out the detailed changelog below:
[olist]
[*] Added Free Ride mode, allowing players to freely roam around the industrial area.
[*] Updated the lesson rating system. Precision is the only factor considered for 2-star ratings, while time remaining determines 3-star ratings. The stopwatch is disabled by default, but can be enabled in options.
[*] New steering wheel and controller system. Improved Force Feedback (FFB) for steering wheels and vibrations for gamepads.
[*] Added multi-monitor support.
[*] Enhanced audio quality and spatial localization of sounds.
[*] Implemented performance optimization resulting in smoother gameplay across various hardware configurations.
[*] Added a new trailer for an engaging hauling experience.
[*] Introduced several new functionalities, including interactive gates and barriers.
[*] Added an option to mute menu music.
[*] Adjusted mission difficulty for a more realistic experience.
[*] Fixed issues with completing Tutorial steps.
[*] Refined driving physics parameters, including gearbox operation and ground friction.
[*] Corrected inaccurate star counting for completed lessons.
[*] Developed documentation for common issues available on our support website at support.truckworldstudio.com, which will be regularly updated.
[/olist]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952360/Truck_World_Driving_School/

We hope you enjoy these updates and enhancements in version 1.2 of Truck World: Driving School. Get behind the wheel and rediscover your love for truck driving with an even more immersive and realistic experience!

notes.title: Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
G’day, mates! 

We’re hard at work making Truck World Australia a next-level experience for you truckers. Today we want to share with you the gameplay reveal video with the features you can expect at the game release. 

[previewyoutube=kybOVWu_jEA;full][/previewyoutube]
Just to recap, here’s what’s coming:

[h3]Interactive cabin[/h3]
And what a cabin it is! You can interact with just about anything you can find in your comfy truck cabin, from crucial vehicle controls to fancy mementos. 

[h3]Step out for a stroll[/h3]
Sleepy legs? Well, how nice it will be to hop off and inspect your truck in person! Not to mention you’ll need to do that in order to attach trailers, secure the load, and much more. 

[h3]Visual hints[/h3]
As an option, you can enable a third-person view during certain actions to make your life a little bit easier: after all, it’s all about having fun! 

And that’s all for now, much more coming up soon! Follow and Wishlist Truck World Australia to get the news first!

See ya out there!

tags.feature: You can interact with just about anything you can find in your comfy truck cabin, from crucial vehicle controls to fancy mementos.
Well, how nice it will be to hop off and inspect your truck in person!
As an option, you can enable a third-person view during certain actions to make your life a little bit easier: after all, it’s all about having fun!
